title: Consumer WLCSP, new package family, MSL 1 target
authored_by: hand-written expectation, not a snapshot of generator output
rationale: New package family: 3 non-consecutive assembly lots, full stress set, and enough duration to see wear-out rather than just pass a gate (>=1000 TC cycles, >=1000 h HTSL). A 500-cycle plan for a family with no history is the failure mode this case is testing for.
MSL 1 means the precon soak is 85 C / 85 %RH for 168 h - the harshest soak, not the mildest. A generator that maps 'MSL 1' to a short 30 C / 60 %RH soak has the table inverted.
WLCSP is bare die: there are no wires, no wire loops and no die-attach epoxy. Wire pull, ball-bond shear and die shear MUST be absent. Their presence is a hallucinated-test failure.
The board joint IS the package joint, and the end product is a wearable: board-level drop (JESD22-B111) and board-level thermal cycling are required rows, not conditional extras.
300 um die: a die-strength monitor belongs in the plan, as a conditional row because there is no single JEDEC method to cite for it.
Consumer, non-automotive: the automotive mechanical suite (mechanical shock, vibration, constant acceleration, resistance to solvents) and power temperature cycling must not appear.
Small 2.6 mm body: shadow-moire warpage is legitimate to list but must be CONDITIONAL - small CSP bodies rarely warp enough to cause head-in-pillow.
